question.prompt:
In rectangle \(ABCD\), \(AB=5\) and \(AD=3\). Fold along \(AE\) so that \(B\) lands at point \(F\) on side \(CD\). Find \(CF\). (\(E\) lies on \(BC\); enter only the length of \(CF\).)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_192_q1_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: After folding, \(AF=AB=5\). In right triangle \(ADF\), \(DF=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4\), so \(CF=CD-DF=5-4=1\).
solutions.title: Folding and the Pythagorean theorem
